name: cypress-saucedemo-tests
description: Cypress + TypeScript E2E test suite for saucedemo.com

scripts.test:report: rimraf cypress/reports && cypress run --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=cypress/reports/raw,overwrite=false,html=false,json=true && npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate
scripts.report:generate: marge cypress/reports/merged-report.json --reportDir . --inline --charts --reportTitle "SauceDemo Test Results" --reportPageTitle "SauceDemo E2E Test Report"
